# AeroInfo India

> AeroInfo India is a digital platform providing interactive Indian airspace visualization, ATS navigation routes, real-time METAR and TAF aviation weather reports, NOTAMs, and aeronautical charts.

## Core Features & Information
- **AeroInfo Map App**: [AeroInfo App](https://aeroinfo.in/app) - Interactive 2D/3D map visualization for Indian airspace structures, FIR boundaries, waypoints, Navaids, ATS routes, live wind/cloud weather overlays, and real-time METAR/TAF.
- **Aeronautical Information**: Electronic Aeronautical Information Publication (eAIP) data for situational awareness, research, and educational purposes.
- **Disclaimer**: Strictly intended for situational awareness and research. Not certified for real-world flight navigation.

## Links & Resources
